body: Opus2 shell rule after the 2026-11-07 00:22Z incident: in Git Bash, NEVER put message text inline in double quotes for "$TERMAL_CLI" mailbox send --message "...". Backticks (for example `cargo run --release`) or $(...) inside run as commands. That incident started a second TermAl cargo run in the main checkout; it was stopped before link and the installed binary was unchanged. Always write the body with a single-quoted heredoc (cat > file <<'EOF') and send it with --message-file.
